name: Memory: UNLOCKED
source:
Min-ji is a college graduate leading a simple life. She wakes, leaves for work and returns home. Rinse and repeat.

One day, she discovers the manual for an online RPG she used to adore lying open on her desk—one she had long thought lost.

Curiously compelled to return to Fablewood, Min-ji scours the game for the one item she never obtained with the help of a complete stranger.

But what is the puzzling force drawing Min-ji back to Fablewood, and who is the mysterious other player known only as 'Fenix'?

[from [url=https://fableandclover.itch.io/memory-unlocked]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
敏智是一名大学毕业生，过着简单的生活。她醒来，去上班，然后回家。冲洗并重复。

有一天，她在桌子上发现了一本她曾经喜欢的在线角色扮演游戏的手册——她一直以为它已经丢失了。

出于好奇，敏姬被迫返回法布尔伍德，她在游戏中搜寻一件她从未在陌生人的帮助下获得的物品。

但究竟是什么力量将敏智带回了法布尔伍德，而另一个只被称为“菲尼克斯”的神秘玩家又是谁呢？

[来自[url=https://fableandclover.itch.io/memory-unlocked]itch.io[/url]]
